title: The Architect's Toll: Mira Protocol | ECHO//100 Episode 37
description:
Kavi faces an impossible ultimatum as the city’s gravity collapses into a lethal, ninety-degree shift. He must choose between liberating Mira or maintaining the false reality protecting the trapped inhabitants. Episode 37 of ECHO//100: ARC. This content is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Gravity shifts violently, slamming the inhabitants against the cold, vertical steel of the city walls.
scenes.caption: Gravity shifts violently
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses clinging to a vertical wall in a city street, wide angle.

scenes.text: Kavi forces his way toward the core, burdened by the crushing weight of his forgotten duty.
scenes.caption: Kavi fights gravity
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi crawling up a wall, Mira's blue holographic coat visible in the distance through a glass window.

scenes.text: Collapsing the city frees Mira, yet every soul inside faces total erasure into the void.
scenes.caption: The impossible ultimatum
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring at a glowing console, Byte hovering beside him with a concerned cyan face.

scenes.text: Preserving their lives traps them within this lie, forever ignorant of the fake sky above.
scenes.caption: Trapped in a lie
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi looking at the holographic skeletons of citizens frozen in the city streets.

scenes.text: Byte pulses orange, projecting a data stream that defies the warden’s rigid, programmed physical laws.
scenes.caption: Byte hacks reality
scenes.image_prompt: Byte's orange antenna glowing intensely, casting light on the fractured, cracking geometry of the city walls.

scenes.text: Kavi chooses to merge the city with the discarded timeline, forging a space for truth.
scenes.caption: A third option
scenes.image_prompt: Byte hovering between Kavi and a swirling, unstable rift in the center of the city square.

scenes.text: He initiates the merge, tearing the fabric of the current world to stitch it into history.
scenes.caption: Merging the timelines
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's hands glowing with blue light as he interfaces with the core, the city landscape warping.

scenes.text: A jagged red doorway expands instantly, swallowing the architecture as the entire city begins to dissolve.
scenes.caption: The city consumed
scenes.image_prompt: A massive, terrifying red doorway tearing through the city skyline, swallowing buildings into total darkness.
